mapper.select: WITH eligible AS ( SELECT w.id ), saves AS ( SELECT s.work_id, SUM(s.favorite) AS favorite_count, SUM(s.wishlist) AS wishlist_count FROM fl_saved_work s JOIN eligible e ON e.id = s.work_id GROUP BY s.work_id ), engagement AS ( SELECT p.work_id, SUM(p.view_count) AS view_count, SUM((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fl_forum_comment c WHERE c.post_id = p.id AND c.state = 'VISIBLE')) AS comment_count, SUM((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fl_forum_like l WHERE l.post_id = p.id)) AS like_count FROM fl_forum_post p JOIN eligible e ON e.id = p.work_id WHERE p.state = 'VISIBLE' GROUP BY p.work_id ), stats AS ( SELECT e.id AS work_id, COALESCE(s.favorite_count, 0) AS favorite_count, COALESCE(s.wishlist_count, 0) AS wishlist_count, COALESCE(p.comment_count, 0) AS comment_count, COALESCE(p.like_count, 0) AS like_count, COALESCE(p.view_count, 0) AS view_count FROM eligible e LEFT JOIN saves s ON s.work_id = e.id LEFT JOIN engagement p ON p.work_id = e.id ) SELECT work_id, favorite_count, wishlist_count, comment_count, like_count, view_count, 4 * favorite_count + 2 * wishlist_count + 3 * comment_count + 2 * like_count + LEAST(view_count, 100) AS score FROM stats WHERE favorite_count + wishlist_count + comment_count + like_count + view_count > 0 ORDER BY score DESC, work_id DESC FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT w.id ORDER BY w.added_at DESC NULLS LAST, w.release_date DESC NULLS LAST, w.id DESC FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT w.id AND w.editorial_rank IS NOT NULL ORDER BY w.editorial_rank, w.id FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT s.work_id, t.id, t.slug, t.name FROM fl_saved_work s JOIN fl_work_tag wt ON wt.work_id = s.work_id JOIN fl_tag t ON t.id = wt.tag_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT w.id AS work_id, w.work_type AS type, wt.tag_id
LEFT JOIN fl_work_tag wt ON wt.work_id = w.id WHERE AND w.work_type = #{type} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fl_saved_work s WHERE s.user_id = #{excludeUser} AND s.work_id = w.id) ORDER BY w.id, wt.tag_id
